apps.name: YouMod
apps.subtitle: YouTube with YTLite-like features, free.
apps.localizedDescription:
YouMod is a modified YouTube app that recreates the features of YTLite — completely free.

Includes video, audio and thumbnail downloading, built-in SponsorBlock, extensive appearance and theming options, ad and Shorts removal, navigation bar and tab bar customization, automatic quality and audio track selection, custom playback speed and gestures, and a fully redesigned settings panel.

versions.localizedDescription:
YouMod v2.0.0 — a large release focused on fixes, improvements and a lot of new features.

ADDED
• Built-in SponsorBlock integration
• Completely redesigned settings UI and logic

DOWNLOADING
• Fixed videos that could not be saved to Photos or were unplayable
• Audio downloads now use the original source
• New progress dialog, plus a sheet header showing video details
• Options to copy video, comment and post information
• Download button added to Shorts; improved thumbnail handling
• Fixed download options missing on iPhone layout and older YouTube versions

PLAYER
• Automatic quality selection per connection type and Low Power Mode
• Automatic audio and caption track selection
• Default playback speed, custom hold-to-speed gesture, tap to seek
• Estimated end time on the duration display
• Options to hide related videos, comments and quick actions
• Fixed channel watermarks and paid promotion banners not being removed

SHORTS
• Shorts-only mode, pinch to toggle fullscreen, hide player elements

FEED & APPEARANCE
• Fixed new ad types not being removed
• Options to hide horizontal shelves and the Shorts shelf
• Fixed OLED theme not applying in some areas

TAB BAR
• Frosted tab bar style and 17 additional tabs including History and Watch Later

Credit to the upstream YouMod project and its contributors.
